status_reviews.researcher_notes: Required status-review verdict: 'unclear'. The only document found discussing this branch's commissioning (chndaqi.com Shangrao plan) is in mild tension with GEM's 'operating' status -- it dates construction start to 2019-03 but says the two end counties still lacked gas connection as of end-2021. GEM's own last-verified date (2023-09-01) postdates that document, so it is plausible the connection was completed 2022-2023 and the tension is just staleness in the document, not in GEM's data. Searched for a newer confirming source (gas.in-en.com candidate confirmed 403 access failure with no Wayback capture available; general web search found nothing more recent specific to Guangfeng-Yushan) -- none found either way. Leaving Status as-is (not proposing a change) given no positive contradicting evidence, but flagging for a human check given the 2021 tension and the 2+ year data-staleness gap.
